rationale: Both source clocks and both mux-output clock modes are declared, the modes are logically exclusive, and the strap is explicitly static before the selected-clock interface delays are applied.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the two-input glitch-free mux to a static-strap clock selector and one capture register.

mutation.description: The static strap selects the first clock in this test configuration; the alternate clock remains constrained as an exclusive mode.
